hints.title: Divisibility Condition
hints.text: A pair (i, j) is good if nums1[i] is divisible by nums2[j] * k.

hints.title: Nested Loop
hints.text: Given small array sizes, iterate over each element of nums1 and each element of nums2.

hints.title: Modulo Check
hints.text: Check if nums1[i] % (nums2[j] * k) == 0 and increment the counter.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct nested evaluation over input lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; constraints n, m <= 50 allow straightforward double iteration.
